newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE TRADE SLOWS DOWN, TALSE FALLS IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE TRADE SLOWS DOWN, TALSE FALLS IN MAY.

text.p: Total turnover on the Tallinn bourse fell by 57 million kroons to 906 million kroons in May and the Talse index lost 3.79 percent to close at 251.48, the stock exchange said on Monday.

The main list accounted for 83 percent and the free market 17 percent of total turnover, it added in its monthly statistics sheet. Hansapank was the most active stock in May with trade of 235 million kroons or 26 percent of total turnover.
On the main list, Tallinna Pank was the biggest loser to close 16.02 percent lower at 60.30 kroons.
Hoiupank gained the most or 3.36 percent to close at 132.25 kroons.
